companyDescription: FORCE™ muscle-targeted oligonucleotides · z-rostudirsen BLA (exon 51 DMD) under priority review, PDUFA Jan 21, 2027; z-basivarsen (DM1) registrational ACHIEVE data Q1 2027
priceNote: Live $17.92 (-0.7%) on Nov 11, 2026. The 52-week range is $14.00–$27.31. Market cap is ~$3.3B (~187M shares). It is below the July 2026 offering price of $20.50 after peer Novartis data cut targets. Cash is $1.134B.
summary: This is a two-step regulatory and data moonshot. First, z-rostudirsen (exon 51 DMD) has a priority-review PDUFA on Jan 21, 2027 for accelerated approval on dystrophin expression, the same pathway that sent SRPT +74% in 2016. Then z-basivarsen's registrational ACHIEVE data in DM1 (Q1 2027) is the bigger TAM, since there is no approved DM1 therapy. Targets were cut after peer Novartis data (Baird $26, RBC $30, MS $36; HCW $50; consensus ~$34). The stock trades below its July $20.50 raise with $1.13B cash, so there is no survival flag. fda_decision is a Tier-2 leader (+9.3pp vs +2.0, n=10). At ~$3.3B the cap is under the $5B ceiling, but the Moon (+200%) needs both catalysts to land. R/R is below 5:1, so size at the low end. Base +45% (~$26) is a post-approval re-rating, above the lane's realized 30d P75 (+12.2%; Base bias +72.7pp), with a ~3-month horizon. แนะนำ 2% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้า CRL ลงได้ 40%+.

catalysts.name: z-rostudirsen PDUFA — exon 51 DMD (priority review)
catalysts.description: BLA accepted Jul 2026 with Priority Review, seeking accelerated approval on dystrophin expression. PDUFA target action date is Jan 21, 2027, and the company is preparing a Q1 2027 launch.

catalysts.name: z-basivarsen ACHIEVE registrational topline — DM1
catalysts.description: Registrational expansion cohort data in myotonic dystrophy type 1, planned for Q1 2027 to support an accelerated-approval BLA in Q3 2027. There is no approved DM1 therapy.

risks: A CRL or delay on z-rostudirsen. Accelerated approvals on dystrophin are contested, and peer Capricor fell ~38% on a DMD CRL (Jul 2025).
Competitive read-through: Novartis data already forced target cuts. Exon 51 is a small slice of DMD (~13%), with Sarepta incumbent.
At ~$3.3B, a 200%+ move needs DM1 success on top of approval. This is the weakest Moon math in the set.
Heavy burn: Q3 net loss ~$194M with launch costs ramping. Cash of $1.13B covers it, but expect raises after positive news.
R/R is only ~3.6:1 vs the 5:1 turbo target.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: The Fed held at 3.75–4.00% on Oct 28. After the hot Oct CPI on Nov 10, CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~89–100%, with ~10% odds of 50bp. The 10-year is ~4.98%.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct CPI: headline +0.4% m/m, core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2% expected. Sep core PCE was 3.1% y/y. Oct PCE on Nov 25 is the next print, then Nov CPI on Dec 10, the day after FOMC.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Mid-cap rare-disease biotech moving to commercial. Well funded. Rates matter through the biotech multiple and the cost of the next raise.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — the PDUFA falls after the Dec 9 hike and the Dec 10 CPI, so the macro shock comes before the binary. Use any December weakness to build the position.

entryStrategy.verdict: SPECULATIVE · ค่าขนม 2% max — a dated priority-review PDUFA in a Tier-2 leader catalyst type (fda_decision +9.3pp) at a depressed price. R/R is only ~3.6:1 and the cap is ~$3.3B, so keep it small. Measured turbo at-catalyst median is -13.7% (n=19), so Entry 2 is preferred and Entry 1 is a starter only.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Rare-disease PDUFA names often drift up in the final 2–4 weeks. SRPT rose 20%+ in the week before its 2016 approval on FDA-personnel news. DYN is currently drifting below its raise price instead.

postWin.note: SRPT closed +74% (intraday +90%) on the eteplirsen accelerated approval, the same dystrophin-surrogate pathway. DYN is a larger cap with competition, so a +30–50% re-rating is the realistic base.

postLose.note: CAPR opened -38.6% on a DMD CRL (deramiocel, Jul 11, 2025). Reports ranged from -26% to -53% depending on timing.

spotSizing.reason: 2%. fda_decision is the strongest Tier-2 leader (+9.3pp vs +2.0, n=10, 0/10 windows with SPY down >2%), which is supportive. But R/R is ~3.6:1 (below 5:1) and the cap is ~$3.3B, so it stays at the turbo floor.

stopPreCatalyst.note: Wider than the turbo medianMAE (-24.1%). A close below ~$13.40 breaks the 52-week-low area and means the market is pricing a CRL.

stopPostCatalyst.note: On a CRL, exit day 1. On approval, trail the stop to the $20.50 raise price.

comparableCases.note: Same exon, same dystrophin-surrogate pathway. This is the upside template, though SRPT was first-in-class and DYN is not.
DMD regulatory-failure template: a CRL for lack of substantial evidence plus CMC issues.

แรงกดจากคู่แข่ง: ข้อมูล Novartis ทำให้ถูกลดเป้าไปแล้ว exon 51 เป็นส่วนเล็กของ DMD (~13%) และมี Sarepta เป็นผู้เล่นเดิม
ที่ ~$3.3B การวิ่ง 200%+ ต้องได้ทั้ง DM1 และการอนุมัติ — คณิตศาสตร์ Moon อ่อนที่สุดในชุดนี้
เผาเงินหนัก: ขาดทุนสุทธิ Q3 ~$194M และต้นทุนเปิดตลาดเพิ่มขึ้น เงินสด $1.13B รองรับได้ แต่คาดว่าจะเพิ่มทุนหลังข่าวดี
R/R แค่ ~3.6:1 เทียบเป้า 5:1 ของ turbo

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed คงดอกเบี้ย 3.75–4.00% เมื่อ 28 ต.ค. หลัง CPI ต.ค. ออกมาร้อน (10 พ.ย.) CME FedWatch ให้โอกาสขึ้น 25bp ในประชุม 9 ธ.ค. ราว 89–100% และโอกาสขึ้น 50bp ~10% ส่วน yield 10 ปีอยู่ ~4.98%
